external_coverage.exact_statement: For an irreducible projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field and an actual ample rational bundle Ω, each rational divisorial valuation v, including the generic trivial valuation, admits a continuous PL function ψ such that sup_K(u−ψ)=(u−ψ)(v) for every genuine Ω-psh u. Consequently, for every nonempty uniformly upper bounded such family with raw supremum S, S*(v)=S(v). BJ arXiv:1801.08229v4, Theorem 5.6 and Lemma 5.7.

For an irreducible projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, an ample class Ω having the envelope property, and a nonempty uniformly upper bounded family of genuine Ω-psh functions with raw supremum S, every subset of {S<S*}, without a Borel hypothesis, is contained in the pole set of a genuine Ω-psh function. BJ arXiv:1801.08229v4, Theorem 13.17 and Lemma 13.19.

On smooth projective varieties over algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields, algebraic positive products preserve pseudoeffective order, are symmetric and separately homogeneous, and equal ordinary products for nef entries. On big classes they are continuous and are suprema of products of dominated nef Cartier classes on birational models. The resulting inequalities hold against fixed nef tests. BFJ arXiv:math/0608260v2, §2.

For a projective d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, volume is numerical, continuous, homogeneous of degree d, zero outside the big cone, and has concave d-th root on the big cone. It is C1 there, with Dvol_α(H)=d⟨α^(d−1)⟩·H. BFJ arXiv:math/0608260v2, Theorem A and §§2–3.

On a projective d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, if β≤ω is nef, ω is nef and big, and ω±H are nef, then vol(β±tH)≥β^d±dtβ^(d−1)·H−Ct² for 0≤t≤1, with C depending only on d and ω^d. BFJ arXiv:math/0608260v2, Corollary 3.4.

For an actual big rational Cartier divisor D on an integral projective d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, h0(mD)=vol(D)m^d/d!+o(m^d) along denominator-cleared positive degrees, without countability or finite generation of its section ring. Lazarsfeld–Mustață, Convex Bodies Associated to Linear Series, published 2009 text, Proposition 2.1, Lemma 2.2 and Theorem 2.3.

For an actual big rational divisor D on a smooth integral projective d-fold over any algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, principalizing the complete |mD| base ideal gives μ_m*(mD)=M_m+F_m with M_m generated and F_m effective, and (M_m/m)^d→vol(D) along all sufficiently large denominator-cleared degrees. No section-ring finite-generation or field-countability hypothesis is required. Lazarsfeld–Mustață, published 2009 text, Theorem 3.3 and Remarks 3.4 and 3.7.

On a smooth variety over a characteristic-zero field, a coherent nonzero ideal can be principalized by finitely many blowups with smooth centers compatible with a prescribed SNC boundary, making its total transform an invertible effective SNC ideal. The construction is unchanged off the ideal's zero locus and is functorial for smooth morphisms and field extensions. Invariant ideals therefore admit equivariant principalizations. Włodarczyk, Simple Hironaka Resolution in Characteristic Zero, JAMS 18 (2005).

For projective varieties over the retained fields, ampleness of an actual rational bundle depends only on its numerical class; the ample cone is open and convex, its closure is the nef cone, and a nef class plus a positive ample class is ample. Vakil, Foundations of Algebraic Geometry, 27 June 2011 version, §22.3.

If p:Y→X is proper birational, Y is integral and reduced, and X is integral and normal, then p_*O_Y=O_X. Consequently H0(Y,p*B)=H0(X,B) for every actual line bundle B, and for rational bundles after denominator clearing. Stacks Project, Lemma 37.53.6, tag 0AY8, and projection formula.

If X is a projective noetherian scheme, H is an actual ample integral line bundle and F is coherent, then F⊗H^m is globally generated for every sufficiently large integer m. Stacks Project, Proposition 28.27.13, tag 01PR.
